about: SOP-BERT fitted confidence and its thresholds for the demo, for the model of arm refit (docs/model/neural/sop-bert; FEEDBACK_PLAN.md, FEEDBACK_RESULT.md). Fitted on the fresh2 calibration part (training/sketch/llm_bench/fresh2/opus_a..d, messages with int(sha256(id), 16) % 3 == 0) by training/sketch/fresh2/fit_report.mjs (EXPORT) from the arm's records (gpu-runs:results/079_measure_round2/refit/records/sop_arm_own.jsonl), written by training/sketch/fresh2/export_confidence.mjs. Same format as training/sketch/precision_thresholds_bert.json, plus the "cost" level.
protocol: FRESH2_PLAN.md / FEEDBACK_PLAN.md: the logistic over the 24 signals, percentile maps, act prior and L2 fitted on the fresh2 calibration part only (368 messages, 808 requested actions, 854 produced requests), 5 folds by message, L2 from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} by out-of-fold AUROC; the default level "cost" is the threshold that maximises the cost score (one confident mistake = 10 right answers, AGENTS.md) on the out-of-fold calibration confidences (a tie keeps the higher threshold); 95/97/99: the lowest threshold whose out-of-fold precision of execution is >= the level with >= 50 executed. The final model (refit on all of the calibration part) is applied unchanged elsewhere. Test part (745 messages, 1745 requested actions) at the cost threshold: score 29.1 [24.0, 33.9].
levels_note: levels_out_of_fold.cost is the default (the owner's decision 2026-11-02 21:24). A level that is null is not reached on the calibration part with at least 50 executed. heldout_* = the fresh2 calibration part (names kept from precision_thresholds_bert.json); test_* = the fresh2 test part at the cost threshold (reported, never used to choose). No levels_in_sample: fit_report.mjs reads every threshold from out-of-fold confidences. Levels cost5 ('bolder': one confident mistake counts as 5 right answers) and cost20 ('more careful': as 20): the cost-score optimum at that cost on the same out-of-fold calibration confidences (added 2026-11-02 by training/sketch/combine/combined_report.mjs EXPORT=1; the weights are unchanged). Levels cost1 and cost2 (bolder still: one confident mistake counts as 1 or 2 right answers), chosen the same way (added 2026-11-03).
how_to: Execute a request when confidence >= threshold (the default: levels_out_of_fold.cost.threshold = threshold). confidence = bertConfidence(spec, f, act) of training/sketch/precision_confidence_bert.mjs (z = intercept + sum(weight_i * percentile_i), 1/(1+exp(-z)); percentile as described in that file: null/undefined signal -> 1; act_prior: act_prior[act], else act_prior_default; the signals f come from precision_bert_collect.mjs `features`).
